rationale: The assistant correctly narrowed to the battery as the leading suspect, stayed non-invasive, respected the refusal to open anything, and expressed appropriate uncertainty. However, it never asked about the declining runtime or whether the light was flashing versus solid, and the third turn repeated the handheld-only test from turn two. It also handed off to Dyson only as an alternative rather than clearly recommending Dyson support with the serial number, and it did not mention that a replacement battery is the likely fix.
